args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest production deploy) was failing health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of ~18%. Rolled back checkout-api in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback status: rolled_out in us-east, us-west, eu-west. Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging prior to the production deploy. Follow-up: investigate root cause of the v2.3.1 failure and confirm recovery.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and the service is healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Cause:** v2.3.1, the latest release, was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an error rate of about 18%.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production, so I rolled back to it.
- **Result:** All three regions now run v2.3.0, and the error rate is down to about 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 says what failed, that the rollback was done and where, and that the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure still needs investigating.

The release candidate for v2.3.1 (v2.3.1-rc) had also failed in staging before it went to production. I put this in the incident so it can be part of the follow-up.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
